name: momo-ai
description: momo.ai — plant care app (built part by part)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @verdia/web && npm run dev -w @verdia/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @verdia/web && npm run dev -w @verdia/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @verdia/contracts && npm run build -w @verdia/web && npm run build -w @verdia/api
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @verdia/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @verdia/contracts && npm run test -w @verdia/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @verdia/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @verdia/api && npm run typecheck -w @verdia/web
